gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-julius-sans-one: Expressive spaghetti-like strokes lead in Funnel Display, all one width and never pinching shut. Julius Sans One follows with a plain sans and wide gaps between letters, which is where the pair gets its charm.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera reads like a plotter drawing, one line weight with open curves and letters spaced like stepping stones. And Goldman above it is the opposite, bold and commanding, with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-almendra-display-roboto-slab: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. Roboto Slab takes over below, and a modest body size lets its slab-serif middle zone do the work.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend-p: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height, and Lexend Peta brings a big x-height too. Both stay chunky, so paragraphs feel friendly.
gen-audiowide-bitter: Bitter reads sturdy, with a big lowercase eye and open s shapes. Audiowide sits above it, futuristic and tile-like, so the slab-serif body keeps the page grounded while the heading looks ahead.
gen-flavors-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates reads contemporary, with open paperclip-bent c shapes and round letters whose rims match the stems, while Flavors above it is whimsical and towering. Paragraphs feel brisk and friendly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend-giga: Round, punchy, and bold: Autour One has clear channels into each round letter and no hairline shifts. Lexend Giga matches it with flat single-weight lines and generous tracking, a sans that feels modern.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-exa: Bold and expressive, Grandstander holds its letters open with short ascenders and a tall x-height, and Lexend Exa echoes that with wide curves and stubby ascenders. They feel like kin.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-mega: Wide, high-waisted, and commanding, Metamorphous has generous sidebearings and soft stroke contrast. And Lexend Mega, a sans drawn with one nib, looks best at a comfortable text size beneath it.
gen-audiowide-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab brings a precise, structured slab-serif texture where the middle of each line dominates, with open throats in a, c, e, and s. Audiowide feels futuristic beside it.
